description: Frontend predictions dashboard. Adds frontend/src/api/predictions.ts (typed, using the existing axios apiClient), frontend/src/store/predictionsStore.ts (Zustand, plain create, no persistence), adds recharts to frontend/package.json, and REWRITES frontend/src/pages/PredictionsPage.tsx to replace the 'Coming Soon' placeholder with a full 3-section dashboard (rate calculator, fuel estimator, demand heatmap) using recharts. Build-toolchain: npm + tsc; verification is `npm install` (installs recharts) + `npx tsc --noEmit`. Runtime depends on FEAT-002 (backend proxy); the TS build is independent.
steps: Modify frontend/package.json: add `"recharts": "^2.15.0"` to dependencies, kept alphabetically sorted (after react-router-dom, before zustand). Do not bump any other version.

Create frontend/src/api/predictions.ts using `apiClient` from './client' (same pattern as api/loads.ts). Define and export typed response interfaces (RatePrediction, FuelPriceResponse, FuelCostResponse, DemandLane, DemandForecastDay) and a `predictionsApi` object: getRatePrediction(params:{market, equipmentType, distance, dayOfWeek, fuelPrice}) -> apiClient.get('/predictions/rate', {params}).then(r=>r.data); getFuelPrice(market) -> apiClient.get(`/predictions/fuel/${market}`).then(r=>r.data); getFuelCost(market, distance) -> apiClient.get('/predictions/fuel-cost', {params:{market, distance}}).then(r=>r.data); getDemandHeatmap(market) -> apiClient.get(`/predictions/demand/${market}`).then(r=>r.data); getDemandForecast(body:{origin, destination, market, days}) -> apiClient.post('/predictions/demand/forecast', body).then(r=>r.data).

Create frontend/src/store/predictionsStore.ts (Zustand, plain create<PredictionsState>()((set) => ({...})), no middleware). State: ratePrediction (RatePrediction|null), fuelPrice (FuelPriceResponse|null), fuelCost (FuelCostResponse|null), demandHeatmap (DemandLane[]), demandForecast (DemandForecastDay[]), loading (boolean), error (string|null). Actions follow the loadsStore try/catch->set({error}) pattern: fetchRatePrediction(params), fetchFuelPrice(market), fetchFuelCost(market, distance), fetchDemandHeatmap(market), fetchDemandForecast(body), clear(). Each fetch sets {loading:true, error:null} then the data + {loading:false}, catch sets {error: msg, loading:false}.

Rewrite frontend/src/pages/PredictionsPage.tsx: delete ALL 'Coming Soon' content. Import Layout from '../components/Layout'; useMarketStore from '../store/marketStore'; usePredictionsStore from '../store/predictionsStore'; recharts components (BarChart, Bar, LineChart, Line, XAxis, YAxis, Tooltip, ResponsiveContainer, CartesianGrid, Legend) from 'recharts'; icons from 'lucide-react' (TrendingUp, Fuel, MapPin, Calculator). Use local useState for form inputs (market, equipment, distance, dayOfWeek, fuelPrice) and selectedLane; read data from the store. On mount (useEffect): fetchFuelPrice(market) and fetchDemandHeatmap(market); when market changes refetch both. Equipment list depends on market (USA: Flatbed/Dry Van/Reefer/Step Deck/Lowboy; Europe: Tautliner/Mega/Frigo/Flatbed/Coil). Currency badge: USA -> '$', Europe -> 'EUR'; distance unit label: USA 'miles', Europe 'km'. Build three sections in a responsive grid (reuse Tailwind classes navy-900, accent, rounded-2xl, shadow-sm, border-slate-100): SECTION 1 Rate Prediction Calculator (left, lg:col-span-2) — market dropdown (prefilled from marketStore), equipment dropdown, distance number input, day-of-week dropdown (Mon-Sun -> 0-6), fuel price input prefilled from the fuel price API, 'Predict Rate' button calling fetchRatePrediction; result card with predicted rate (large bold), confidence range low - high, currency badge, rate-per-mile/km secondary stat; Recharts BarChart comparing predicted rate vs average market rate (= mean of the heatmap avg_rate for the market). SECTION 2 Fuel Cost Estimator (top right) — current diesel price big number + currency + per gallon/L, Recharts LineChart of the 7-day trend (fuelPrice.trend), fuel cost calculator (distance input -> fetchFuelCost) showing fuel cost, fuel efficiency assumption, fuel price used. SECTION 3 Demand Heatmap (bottom, full width) — market toggle (USA/EUROPE) re-fetching the heatmap; grid of the 15 lanes each with origin -> destination, demand score 0-100 with a colored bar (red 80-100, orange 50-79, green 0-49), load count, avg rate; clicking a lane calls fetchDemandForecast and shows a Recharts LineChart of predicted_loads and predicted_avg_rate over 7 days. Show a loading indicator when store.loading and an error banner when store.error.

Confirm frontend/src/App.tsx already imports PredictionsPage and routes '/predictions' to it inside ProtectedRoute (it does — no change needed). If for any reason the import is missing, restore it to match the existing wiring.
acceptance_criteria: `cd frontend && npm install` exits 0 and installs recharts (a 2.x version lands in node_modules).
`grep -c 'Coming Soon' frontend/src/pages/PredictionsPage.tsx` returns 0 (the placeholder text is gone).
PredictionsPage.tsx renders three sections (rate calculator, fuel estimator, demand heatmap) and imports recharts.
frontend/src/api/predictions.ts and frontend/src/store/predictionsStore.ts exist and type-check.
verification: Run `cd frontend && npm install` and confirm exit code 0; then `node -e "console.log(require('./node_modules/recharts/package.json').version)"` prints a 2.x version.
Run `cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit` and confirm exit code 0 (0 errors).
Run `grep -c 'Coming Soon' frontend/src/pages/PredictionsPage.tsx` and confirm it returns 0.
Run `grep -n 'recharts' frontend/src/pages/PredictionsPage.tsx` and confirm the import is present.
findings: Implemented: added recharts ^2.15.0 to frontend/package.json (sorted after react-router-dom, before zustand); created frontend/src/api/predictions.ts (typed apiClient module: getRatePrediction/getFuelPrice/getFuelCost/getDemandHeatmap/getDemandForecast) and frontend/src/store/predictionsStore.ts (Zustand plain create, no middleware); rewrote frontend/src/pages/PredictionsPage.tsx into a 3-section dashboard (rate calculator with recharts BarChart vs market-avg rate, fuel estimator with recharts LineChart trend + cost calc, demand heatmap with 15 clickable lanes and 7-day forecast recharts LineChart). App.tsx already routes /predictions to PredictionsPage (no change). Verification: `npm install` exit 0 (recharts 2.15.4 installed), `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors, `grep -c 'Coming Soon' PredictionsPage.tsx` = 0, recharts import present.
